اضطرمت (form VIII)
# اِضْطَرَمْتُ (iḍṭaramtu) /idˤ.tˤa.ram.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِضْطَرَمَ (iḍṭarama)
# اِضْطَرَمْتَ (iḍṭaramta) /idˤ.tˤa.ram.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِضْطَرَمَ (iḍṭarama)
# اِضْطَرَمْتِ (iḍṭaramti) /idˤ.tˤa.ram.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِضْطَرَمَ (iḍṭarama)
# اِضْطَرَمَتْ (iḍṭaramat) /idˤ.tˤa.ra.mat/: thi
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
